const job = $input.first().json;
const prompt = `Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Background:
- Bilingual: English (native) and Mandarin
- Grew up in California and Taiwan
- Digital marketing background: SEO, PPC, Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4
- Data science bootcamp graduate
- Technical: Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Projects: dashboards, EDA, machine learning, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

The job:
Title: ${job.job_title}
Company: ${job.company}
Description: ${(job.description || '').slice(0, 1500)}

Write the cover letter specifically for this role. Mention at least one concrete way Jerry can help:
- Reduce manual analysis time
- Improve reporting speed
- Connect marketing data to business decisions
- Build AI-assisted workflows
- Turn messy data into action

Requirements:
- Under 220 words
- Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate
- Do NOT start with "Dear Hiring Manager" — use a strong opening line instead
- Do NOT use clichés like "I am writing to express my interest"
- Mention Taiwan/async availability naturally

Return only the cover letter text.`;
const requestBody = {
  model: 'gpt-4o-mini',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }],
  temperature: 0.7,
  max_tokens: 500
};
return [{ json: { ...job, _cover_letter_request: JSON.stringify(requestBody) } }];
